body:
The texture-view audit continuation remains in progress. The published PR head
is still `d2e9f2f2984d33073386f0267a673fb7ac6478a3`; the connected repairs remain
local until the complete migration families are ready for hosted validation.

The shared GPU work preserves concrete native, parser and progress causes,
cache-first view selection, format/view relationships and the configured native
validation policy. Buffer allocation and write-admission failures now have
structured classifications without changing their arithmetic or diagnostics.

The generated compute work carries admitted parameter roles through signatures,
source generation, calls and cache recipes. Stencil checks actual reflected
buffer stride, grid capacity and signed address arithmetic. Its flat buffer
outputs now reconstruct row and plane coordinates; lower-dimensional texture
projections retain their existing repeated-plane behavior. The current 51-file
generated-source checkpoint has complete thirteen-lens discovery and independent
Code, Rule and Comment Reviews with no remaining finding within that scope.
This is source evidence, not compilation or complete-family acceptance.

Ownership of the remaining connected #774 work is resolved by Bruno's explicit
assignment. The #774 coordinator confirms it has no competing implementation
claim. #780 and #826 have an agreed function split and canonical contracts;
#780 has received the exact generated/native handoff for composition. The
canonical count/stride, Scan/Reduce/extraction consumers, body/hair/armor/metal,
material/export, source-association and lock families remain required work.
Export admission classifications and checked GLB byte-length encoding are also
tracked dependencies. None is silently deferred or cleared by the merge of
#774.

No new tests, cases, test helpers or assertions have been added. No new local
project checks, code push or hosted CI request has been made for this
continuation. The earlier green hosted run applies only to the published head.
Final clearance still requires the complete combined thirteen-lens audit, all
three independent reviews and required hosted checks on one final pushed
revision. Historical software-provider numerical failures and the creator
SIGSEGV remain documented limits, not results for the new local source. No
browser-runtime, hardware-wide, 32-bit, performance or calibrated-rendering
verdict is claimed. This PR will not be merged by the agents.
